visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Interior of a cartoon spaceship cockpit. A pink, blob-shaped character stands before a high-tech console with a red joystick. Behind him, a large grid screen displays a green planet and Earth with a dotted trajectory line. He waves his small hand with a sad facial expression. (2) Cut to a dramatic scene of other cartoon characters, including one in a yellow suit and one with pink hair, crying intensely. Their tears are depicted as thick, flowing blue streams. They wave their hands in a frantic goodbye gesture towards the viewer. (3) A small, white-and-red cartoon rocket ship propelled by a bright orange flame trail glides through the blackness of deep space. White specks represent distant stars. Bold yellow text 再見~~ appears centered at the bottom of the frame. (4) Back inside the ship, the pink character and a smaller red character with glasses engage in a heated discussion. The background is a plain teal color. The pink character gestures with his small hands while the red one looks bewildered. (5) The rocket ship is seen plummeting towards a lush green Earth forest. It crashes through trees with a white impact cloud. The pink character emerges from a hatch, looking around at the leafy environment while a blue bird watches. (6) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the characters at a modern urban plaza. They interact with cacti and palm tree decorations under a night sky. Large graphic text overlays provide specific event dates and local venue details.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves from a simplified cartoon spaceship cockpit and starry space to a green forest on Earth and finally a modern urban park setting at night.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a middle-pitched, clear male voice speaking in a narrative, slightly sad tone about an exhibition ending. A soft synth BGM starts playing at a moderate tempo (~100 BPM) with a friendly texture. (2) A sudden burst of high-pitched, loud sobbing and wailing voices from multiple characters fills the audio space, creating a high-arousal comic atmosphere. This is quickly followed by a sharp whoosh SFX representing a rocket take-off. (3) Two male voices engage in rapid-fire dialogue. One is calm and philosophical, while the other is higher-pitched and questioning. The BGM remains as a steady rhythmic electronic pulse without interference from ambient noise. (4) A loud, sharp buzzer SFX interrupts the dialogue, followed by a brief strategic silence. A voice then makes a good news announcement with a broadcast-like quality, accompanied by a rising electronic shimmer that increases tension. (5) The final segment features a very rapid, stuttering vocal SFX that syncs with a fast-paced, high-energy electronic beat at 140 BPM. A heavy thud impact SFX marks the rocket's crash, followed by a final comedic punchline.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Departure -> Complication -> Landing -> Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a physical exhibition event at PARK2 Caowu Square in Taichung using a comedic, space-themed animated storyline featuring popular IP characters.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed event dates and location are provided via prominent graphic overlays and character dialogue.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly engaging animated short used for social media event marketing. The fast-paced editing and comedic sound design are tailored to capture attention.
